sentences.text: A lymph node or lymph gland , is an ovoid or kidney-shaped organ of the lymphatic system , and of the adaptive immune system , that is widely present throughout the body .	ovoid	oval	organ	Organ (anatomy)	lymphatic system	lymphatic system	adaptive immune system	adaptive immune system	kidney	kidney
They are linked by the lymphatic vessels as a part of the circulatory system .	circulatory system	circulatory system
Lymph nodes are major sites of B and T lymphocytes , and other white blood cells .	B	B cell	T	T cell
Lymph nodes are important for the proper functioning of the immune system , acting as filters for foreign particles and cancer cells .	cancer	cancer
Lymph nodes do not have a detoxification function , which is primarily dealt with by the liver and kidneys .	detoxification	detoxification	liver	liver
In the lymphatic system the lymph node is a secondary lymphoid organ .	organ	Organ (anatomy)	lymphatic system	lymphatic system	secondary lymphoid organ	Lymphatic system#Structure
A lymph node is enclosed in a fibrous capsule and is made up of an outer cortex and an inner medulla .
Lymph nodes also have clinical significance .
They become inflamed or enlarged in various diseases which may range from trivial throat infections , to life-threatening cancers .	inflamed	inflamed	throat infections	Pharyngitis

The condition of the lymph nodes is very important in cancer staging , which decides the treatment to be used , and determines the prognosis .	cancer	cancer	cancer staging	cancer staging	prognosis	prognosis
When swollen , inflamed or enlarged , lymph nodes can be hard , firm or tender .	inflamed	inflamed
